description: Turns a song the user attached (MP3/WAV) into a word-synced lyric video and proposes three visual styles. Pass the lyrics if the user gave them; otherwise they are transcribed from the audio. Takes about 10–40 seconds. Creates a new project each call.

audio.description: The song file the user attached

lyrics.description: Full song lyrics, one line per sung line, if provided by the user

name: create_lyric_video
title: Create lyric video
